title: DISCO: Diachronic Spanish Sonnet Corpus
notes: DISCO is the Diachronic Spanish Sonnet Corpus of ~4,500 Spanish sonnets 15th–20th c. in XML-TEI with metrical annotation and VIAF-linked metadata; the Golden Age subcorpus (15th–17th c.) deliberately includes minor/non-canonical authors, exactly matching the harvest reference 'DISCO Golden Age minor-author sonnets' (150 texts). Distributed under CC-BY 4.0 via GitHub and Zenodo (zenodo.org/records/1193782). The former project site editionsdisco.com no longer resolves (checked Oct 2026), but the project site is mirrored at prf1.org/disco/about.html (200). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: UNED Madrid (Pablo Ruiz Fabo, Helena Bermudez Sabel, Clara Martinez Canton, Jose Calvo Tello)
